description: Create, remove, reconfigure, update a private network. This module has a dependency on 1and1 >= 1.0.

parameters.name: add_members
parameters.description: List of server identifiers (name or id) to be added to the private network. Default: []

parameters.name: api_url
parameters.description: Custom API URL. Overrides the ONEANDONE_API_URL environment variable.

parameters.name: datacenter
parameters.description: The identifier of the datacenter where the private network is created. Choices: "US" "ES" "DE" "GB"

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Set a description for the network.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Private network name used with present state. Used as identifier (id or name) when used with absent state.

parameters.name: network_address
parameters.description: Set a private network space, for example 192.168.1.0.

parameters.name: private_network
parameters.description: The identifier (id or name) of the network used with update state.

parameters.name: remove_members
parameters.description: List of server identifiers (name or id) to be removed from the private network. Default: []

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Define a network’s state to create, remove, or update. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent" "update"

parameters.name: subnet_mask
parameters.description: Set the netmask for the private network, for example 255.255.255.0.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Wait for the instance to be in state ‘running’ before returning. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: wait_interval
parameters.description: Defines the number of seconds to wait when using the _wait_for methods. Default: 5

parameters.name: wait_timeout
parameters.description: How long before wait gives up, in seconds. Default: 600

examples:
- name: Create a private network
  community.general.oneandone_private_network:
    auth_token: oneandone_private_api_key
    name: backup_network
    description: Testing creation of a private network with ansible
    network_address: 70.35.193.100
    subnet_mask: 255.0.0.0
    datacenter: US

- name: Destroy a private network
  community.general.oneandone_private_network:
    auth_token: oneandone_private_api_key
    state: absent
    name: backup_network

- name: Modify the private network
  community.general.oneandone_private_network:
    auth_token: oneandone_private_api_key
    state: update
    private_network: backup_network
    network_address: 192.168.2.0
    subnet_mask: 255.255.255.0

- name: Add members to the private network
  community.general.oneandone_private_network:
    auth_token: oneandone_private_api_key
    state: update
    private_network: backup_network
    add_members:
      - server identifier (id or name)

- name: Remove members from the private network
  community.general.oneandone_private_network:
    auth_token: oneandone_private_api_key
    state: update
    private_network: backup_network
    remove_members:
      - server identifier (id or name)

return_values.name: private_network
return_values.description: Information about the private network. Returned: always Sample: {"id": "55726DEDA20C99CF6F2AF8F18CAC9963", "name": "backup_network"}
